nodes.label: THREE.Box3 Bounding-Box Overestimate Bug
nodes.rationale: THREE.Box3().setFromObject() unions each mesh's local AABB after transforming its corners, overestimating assemblies whose sub-meshes carry internal rotations by 15-25% (seen on a 10-solid M&M pump). Fixed by vertex-accurate computeTightBounds; verified against sample.step (127.00 x 63.50 x 34.92 mm) and the pump (155.91 x 134.20 x 86.29 mm). It was a frontend bug, not a backend one.
